title: Rural Cardiology Desert Atlas — Versioned US County Planning Map of Cardiology Access
description: Version 0.2.0 of an open-source county-level research and planning atlas of adult-cardiology access in the United States. The exact 3,144-county release combines qualifying individual, active, primary-taxonomy CMS NPPES records; CMS Provider of Services hospital and Critical Access Hospital data; a preserved Census batch-geocoder snapshot; authenticated HUD-USPS 2025 Q4 same-state fallback; Census 2025 Gazetteer/TIGER geography; ACS 2024 five-year demographics; the CDC PLACES 2025 release (2023 estimate year) of coronary-heart-disease prevalence; USDA RUCC 2023; and a pinned HRSA primary-care HPSA snapshot. Counts describe qualifying NPPES-listed mapped locations, not verified availability, full-time equivalents, board certification, telehealth coverage, quality, or outcomes. Distances are straight-line geographic estimates, not road distance or travel time. The release contains no patient health information and is a companion planning resource to the HEARTLAND Protocol.
notes: This atlas uses public administrative and aggregate sources and contains no patient health information. NPPES addresses may be stale or administrative. HUD fallback provides a county proxy rather than a verified street-level practice location. The atlas is not a provider directory, referral tool, clinical decision system, or measure of appointment capacity, workforce availability, travel time, quality of care, or patient outcomes. Results and hashes are version-specific.
